purpose: Teach: 役に立ち/即時/役場/強固/着信/インセンティブ/力量/上京

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期から、私の経験が、君に、役に立ちますように、語ってきた。
lines.en: From the company's founding days, I've shared my experiences with you, hoping they would be of use.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Gentle weight on 'shared.' Pause before 'hoping'—the kind of reflection that comes with age. Warm but not sentimental. The voice of someone who has thought about this a long time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員、即時、お父さんの教えを、活かしてくれています、感謝しております。
lines.en: Yes. Our staff has put your teachings into practice right away, and I'm truly grateful for that.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight formal tilt—this is a son speaking to his father in a moment that matters. Steady breath, clear delivery. The gratitude is genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、地元の役場、本当に、お世話になったな、覚えてる、お母さんの実家。
lines.en: When we were starting out, the local government office really helped us. I remember—your mother's family too.
lines.style: Gentle nostalgic drift. Small pause before 'I remember'—sifting through old memories. Soft smile in the voice. The pace slows slightly, like reaching back in time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業からの強固な信頼、私の代でも、引き継いでまいります。
lines.en: Yes. The strong trust we built from the start—I'll carry that forward in my time as well.
lines.style: Steady, resolved. Not defensive—confident in a quiet way. Each phrase lands with intention. The son claiming his own stewardship while honoring the past.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業当時、電話の着信、夜中でも、受けていたな、私たち、必死だった。
lines.en: In those early days, I'd answer the phone even in the middle of the night. We were desperate, really.
lines.style: Quieter here, more intimate. Soft laugh underneath—the kind that comes with looking back at hardship survived. Slight breathiness on 'desperate.' The voice of someone reliving his own hunger.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員のインセンティブ、お父さんの方針、継続しております、創業以来。
lines.en: Yes. That policy of yours for staff incentives—I've kept it going since the beginning.
lines.style: Direct, almost simple. No ornament. This is the son saying: I understand what mattered to you, and I'm stewarding it. Calm confidence. Eye-level steadiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんとして、君の経営力量、本当に、誇りに思っているよ。
lines.en: As your father, I'm genuinely proud of the way you lead.
lines.style: Warm, direct, unguarded. This is the father speaking. No distance. Slight softening in the tone—tenderness that has earned the right to be simple. Weight on 'genuinely.' Brief pause after, letting it land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、若い頃、上京して、創業した、その勇気、私も、見習います。
lines.en: Yes. When you were young and had the courage to go to Tokyo and start the company from nothing—that's what I'm learning from.
lines.style: Reflective, sincere. Not flattery—this is the son genuinely reckoning with his father's strength. Slower pace. Slight emphasis on 'courage.' The voice of someone who understands now what cost his father paid.
